facts.fact: Tick tock——Grant 到达三十英尺外，Leonard 举枪喝止。
facts.anchor: his pistol rising instantly, leveled at Walker’s chest.

facts.fact: Grant 的三冷词：我不在乎——起来走向我。现在。
facts.anchor: I don’t care. Laura, get up and walk toward me. Now.

facts.fact: Laura 起身道歉——Alex 推椅后跳接住平衡。
facts.anchor: taking hold of the back of the chair with her hands and launching it behind her

facts.fact: 打中缺牙侧下颌——chilling crack；Leonard 丢枪逃向干河床。
facts.anchor: knuckles connecting with the side of his jaw where his teeth were missing

facts.fact: 瞄头→降背——射左大腿擒获而非击杀。
facts.anchor: It settled on his head for a moment, then lowered to his back

facts.fact: Grant 要枪私刑：「这是我的镇——你不能从我手里夺走。」
Alex 开枪击毙 Grant（心脏）；Laura 尖叫；Leonard 的咧嘴笑=穿过她心脏的子弹。
facts.anchor: Grant Walker was slumped at her feet, a pool of blood already spreading beneath him.
